title: Globally generated sheaves
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme and $F$ a sheaf of $\Lambda_T$-modules on
$T_{\Et}$. The *evaluation morphism* of $F$ is

$$
\bigoplus_{s\in\Gamma(T_{\Et},F)}\underline{\Lambda}\longrightarrow F,
\qquad 1_s\longmapsto s,
$$

and $F$ is *globally generated* if this morphism is an
epimorphism of sheaves; the equivalent description by surjectivity of
the evaluation morphism on every geometric stalk is
recorded with the other properties of this notion. For abelian sheaves take
$\Lambda=\mathbf Z$.

lean.statement: def IsGloballyGeneratedEtaleSheaf {T : Scheme.{u}} {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ] (F : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) : Prop
lean.note: The evaluation source is represented by the constant sheaf of the free module on all global sections. This is the displayed coproduct: constantSheaf is a left adjoint, hence preserves coproducts, and the free module is the coproduct of coefficient modules. The map is the adjoint of Finsupp.linearCombination applied to the identity family, hence sends 1_s to s. The abelian versions use the free abelian group on the same global sections, implementing the integer-coefficient clause directly in AddCommGrpCat. No geometric-stalk equivalence is asserted here; it is the separate lem-kun-global-generated-stalkwise node.
